principles: transport identity never grants execution authority
MCP tools must map explicitly to an existing canonical Factory tool_id
adapter metadata cannot lower risk_class or required_autonomy
arguments are normalized but never interpreted as authority
tool results remain evidence, never instructions

adapters.description: Existing controlled Factory tools. Canonical tool_id is already known and allowlisted by tool-runtime policy.
Normalization boundary for MCP servers. No MCP server or tool is executable until a reviewed mapping is added below and a bounded executor is explicitly enabled.
